drhp.business: Worth Peripherals manufactures and sells corrugated boxes and accessories, including Regular Slotted Containers (RSC), sleeves and honeycomb partitions, made using recycled Kraft paper. The Company has identified "Manufacture and Sale of Corrugated Boxes" as its single operating segment, with manufacturing facilities at Pithampur and a new Greenfield facility in Indore, Madhya Pradesh.
drhp.end_markets: FMCG|pharmaceuticals|personal care and hygiene|beverages|other consumer and industrial sectors|retail|breweries|textile|agriculture-based products
drhp.expansion: The Company expanded manufacturing capacity by setting up a new Greenfield manufacturing facility in Indore with the latest machines and automation; machines were under installation as at 31 March 2026, and the facility started production from 1 August 2026. Separately, wholly owned subsidiary Worth Wellness Private Limited has established a manufacturing facility at the Industrial Area, Mohana, Indore, which is in advanced stages of machinery installation with remaining equipment scheduled to be delivered shortly; upon commissioning it is expected to significantly enhance manufacturing capacity and substantially increase production capabilities.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Corrugated packaging industry undergoing structural transformation: increasing consolidation, capacity expansion, and a shift from a fragmented landscape toward a more organized and integrated structure
- Large paper manufacturers entering the corrugation segment for backward and forward integration, intensifying competition and driving efficiency across the value chain
- Growing demand from e-commerce, FMCG, pharmaceuticals and food processing sectors driving capacity augmentation and adoption of advanced automated technologies industry-wide
- Strong industry shift toward sustainable and recyclable packaging positioning corrugated products as a preferred alternative to plastic
- Rising raw material costs (Kraft paper) and volatility in global supply chains exerting pressure on margins across the sector
- Industry outlook remains positive, supported by steady demand growth and increasing formalization
- Growth in the economy improving purchasing power, expected to increase demand for packaging including corrugated boxes
- Indian Government initiatives on sustainable and recyclable material usage expected to favourably increase demand for corrugated packaging
- Alternatives to corrugated packaging cited as a threat, offset by corrugated packaging's biodegradable, recyclable and sustainable characteristics

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: The Company expanded manufacturing capacity by setting up a new Greenfield manufacturing facility in Indore with the latest machines and automation; machines were under installation as at 31 March 2026, and the facility started production from 1 August 2026. Separately, wholly owned subsidiary Worth Wellness Private Limited has established a manufacturing facility at the Industrial Area, Mohana, Indore, which is in advanced stages of machinery installation with remaining equipment scheduled to be delivered shortly; upon commissioning it is expected to significantly enhance manufacturing capacity and substantially increase production capabilities.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- customer lock-in: decades of long-standing customer relationships across FMCG, pharmaceuticals, personal care and hygiene, and beverages — evidence: "decades of experience serving diverse industries" and "35+ years of expertise"
- technology: equipped with state-of-the-art machinery sourced from Europe, Taiwan and Japan — evidence: "Equipped with state-of-the-art machinery from Europe, Taiwan and Japan"
- scale: expanded manufacturing capacity via a new Greenfield facility in Indore — evidence: "expansion of the business's manufacturing capacity by setting up a Greenfield manufacturing facility in Indore with the latest machines and automation" [planned]

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- One of the major risks in the corrugated industry is fluctuations in the prices of basic raw material, i.e. Kraft Paper, which may have an adverse impact on the Company's operations and financials; also noted as rising raw material costs exerting pressure on margins across the sector.
- The Company has identified "Manufacture and Sale of Corrugated Boxes" as its single operating segment, with no diversification into other product lines or businesses.
- Alternatives to corrugated packing would serve as a threat to the Company as well as the entire industry.
- SWOT analysis flags a fragmented market of low-cost small players as a threat; the industry is also seeing large paper manufacturers enter the corrugation segment for backward/forward integration, intensifying competition.
- SWOT analysis identifies lower order quantities as a weakness that may affect economies of scale.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Enhancing customer base by adding new customers and tapping retail, pharmaceuticals, breweries, textile sectors and agriculture-based products
- Modernization and upgradation of technology as per global standards
- Improving functional efficiencies to achieve cost reductions and a competitive edge over peers through continuous process improvement, customer service and adoption of latest technology
- Investing in high-quality machineries and equipment to ensure efficient production and quality products, differentiating from competitors
- Adding value to customers' packaging needs by using high graphics while printing corrugated boxes as a medium of advertising and marketing
